_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per curated-snapshot-format.md §2.4 (task T032). force_disposition and is_unique are CURATED-ONLY and are dropped at the bundle boundary (C4/R7): force disposition drives mission play, an explicit 001 non-goal, and the Unique rule is not established from the source, so FR-019 forbids guessing it. restriction_type is the closed vocabulary of reference-db-schema.md §4 at restriction_vocabulary_version 1; anything outside it is the blocking CON-RESTRICTION-VOCAB. message_template is AUTHORED by the producer and carries no publisher wording.
title: Curated factions/<faction-id>/detachments.json

rules.description: Sorted by summary_key. 004 data-model.md §2.2: a detachment may own MORE THAN ONE rule (the measured baseline carries 284 detachment abilities over 261 detachments), so the relation is one-to-many and the rule's own key -- not detachment_id -- is what identifies it. The NAME is always carried and comes from the source (004 FR-022); only the summary is authored and gated, and it lives in curation/detachment-rules/<faction-id>.json rather than here.

summary_key.description: detachment:<detachment-id>:<slug>. Keyed on the rule, so two detachments in different factions sharing a rule name are distinct keys, and a detachment renamed upstream while its rule is unchanged keeps its key and its digest.
